start: A member who has logged this routine before, mid-workout with 4 exercises of working sets ticked

user_sees: Screen titled 'Workout complete', subtitle 'Saved to your history.'
A grey placeholder while it loads, then the big card 'Kg lifted' with today's total, e.g. '1,925 kg'

The workout missing from History afterwards

user_sees: '+45 kg more than previous' in green when today beat last time, or 'Same as previous', or 'Lighter than previous. Every workout counts.'
'Previous: 1,880 kg in Push 1 on 15 Oct'
must_not: Warm-up sets counted in today's kg
A red or scolding line for a lighter day
A comparison with a different routine when this routine has a last time

user_sees: '<workout name> done'
One line like '52 min · 18 sets · 1,925 kg lifted · 2 lifts up'
'That's about a grand piano.' only when the total is near a real weight
must_not: A made-up comparison ('a grizzly bear' for 600 kg)
The duration counting paused time

user_sees: The per-exercise summary with new records on the lifts that beat a best
Done returns to the Workout tab
must_not: The summary shown twice
Back reopening the finished workout as still running

A no-weight workout compared with a weighted one

user_sees: The phone's share sheet with the workout written out as text
must_not: The share sheet opening twice on a fast double tap

user_sees: The Workout tab
